en.headline: Chan says Hong Kong offers businesses growth and long-term capital
en.dek: Financial Secretary tells investors at the Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit that the city connects capital across corporate life cycles.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said Hong Kong is well placed to provide businesses with both growth opportunities and long-term capital.

Speaking on Wednesday during a session with investors on the second day of the Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit in Central, Chan noted that companies need different forms of capital at each stage of development to turn potential into sustained growth.

He said that under the “One Country, Two Systems” framework, Hong Kong is closely connected to the Chinese mainland, while its common law legal system, free flow of capital and international networks provide a trusted environment for global investors to take part in China’s growth. Follow-on fundraising on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange reached HK$570 billion in the first nine months of the year, he added.

Chan said the aim is to expand allocation choices to help investors manage risks and liquidity in support of long-term value creation, while continuing to raise market efficiency with faster approvals and clearer frameworks for new products.

zh.headline: 陳茂波稱香港為企業提供增長機會及長期資本
zh.dek: 財政司司長在國際金融領袖投資峰會向投資者表示，香港可連接企業不同階段所需的資本。
body: 財政司司長陳茂波表示，香港有條件為企業同時提供增長機會及長期資本。
陳茂波周三在中環舉行的國際金融領袖投資峰會第二天，與投資者對談時指出，企業在不同發展階段需要不同形式的資本，才能把潛力轉化為持續增長。
他說，在「一國兩制」下，香港與內地緊密聯繫，普通法制度、資金自由流動及國際網絡，為全球投資者參與中國龐大增長提供受信任的環境。他補充，今年首九個月在香港交易所的後續集資達5700億港元。
陳茂波表示，目標是擴大資產配置選擇，協助投資者管理風險及流動性，以支持長期價值創造，同時繼續提升市場效率，加快審批並為新金融產品提供更清晰框架。
